reviews.text: Thank you for the wonderful rating! It means so much to us that you chose Pet Paradise Houston Hobby. We can’t wait to welcome you both back!
Great customer service!!!
Hi, Carlos. Your feedback is truly appreciated. Thank you so much for the the great rating!
This was disappointing my poor baby is all cut up... while being groom. Please check dog. My poor baby sore from the cuts.
Hi, Steven. We appreciate the rating and are glad we could provide you and your pet with a positive experience! We hope to see you both again soon in Paradise.

I used them for the first time to kennel my three dogs for a week.
Pros: very friendly staff, so convenient if you're flying out of hobby, the rate.
Cons: the video cameras and the angles they have I was never able to see my pets at Play Time. Nor did I have any communication with the kennel I did call them since I did not see them at play time or have any communication with them at all I was just worried a lot ony trip. When I did call they were sweet. When I got back the young lady said yes the cameras were down. I was a little upset as being gone for a week I wanted to at least see them.
2. No personal items for the pets which I understand but I have an older dog with teeth problems and he likes to chew on something.  Anyways I will give them another shot! Again customer service awesome, convenience is a plus and of course price point.
Great experience with pet paradise! The staff were caring, friendly and attentive to all of my little puppies needs. I feel comfortable knowing that he was in good hands. Highly recommend.

To be fully transparent this was our 1st time boarding our dog . They were very nice . The place was clean and organized. Our dog was very nervous as he has never been boarded before.
The gentleman that checked us in was so nice very soft spoken and truly cared about our dog . He listen to us and he made sure he had everything down correctly.
I just wished they had cameras at the facility. We did a report card on our dog Thursday and after that we had to keep calling to get updates at the end of the day . I would definitely be back to board him again in few weeks and in December.

Thank you pet paradise for taking care of our dog

Kim
Hi, Carmen. We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive review. We hope to welcome you and your furry friend back to Paradise soon!

First time leaving our fur babies at a boarding place. I was extremely nervous as they are only 7 months old. I was immediately at ease after day one and they sent our first report card with photos (this cost extra but is worth it) The staff were so warm and friendly and they loved our babies. This kind of service is so important for peace of mind while on vacation. We will definitely be using them again. It was also only 5 minutes from the parking spot at hobby airport. This was a great bonus to the wonderful care our pups got.
Happy to go to them again!
My cat Maxwell was in great hands.

If their faces don't tell you how much they enjoyed themselves at Pet Paradise, I don't know what will.   I will definitely recommend Pet Paradise to anyone that's looking for a place to board their babies or the day camp.  I felt at peace leaving them with a professional, caring team.  I would definitely bring them again without a doubt.  Easy access to Hobby airport and no hassle check in/ check out!!  10 stars if i could!!!!!
Bear really seem to enjoy his stay and loved the group play he seemed happy when I picked him up! This was the first time away and I think the staff made him feel welcomed and comfortable.
Great place for a day of fun for your furry friend! Highly recommended.
My dogs are always tired when I pick them up. Bear actually wanted to go back in!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had a wonderful first experience at Pet Paradise Hobby with our sweet pup, Lil Mama.

Lil Mama has been losing strength and control in her back legs, and we were encouraged by Denise Medina to try the doggy pool. It was her first time in the water, and Annalise and Melissa were incredibly patient, kind, and encouraging. They helped her feel comfortable, and once she got into deeper water, her instincts kicked in and she started swimming using her back legs.

The care and compassion they showed Lil Mama were outstanding. We’re so grateful for the support and look forward to continuing her therapy. I highly recommend Pet Paradise Hobby!
Amazing place. The whole stuff are so attentive and friendly. My dog love to come and spend time here, I think he sees it like a day off. Big thumbs up 👍

I have 2 dogs that stayed for a couple of nights, I got the suite with the live feed, I could see how calm they were, when I picked them up they alert happy which means it was a good stay, and the staff was always very friendly
Very clean and staff was very helpful!
Hi, Alicia. We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive review. We hope to welcome you and your furry friend back to Paradise soon!

Pet Paradise Houston Hobby is fantastic. The staff is friendly, the facility is clean, and they took great care of my dog. Drop-off and pickup were easy, and I felt completely comfortable leaving my pup with them. Highly recommend!

Pet Paradise is a great place for the pets to vacation.  The staff is outstanding, the prices are reasonable, the facility is clean and safe.
Thanks for making me feel that my pets are in good hands
Hi, Tennis. Thank you for the wonderful rating! We can't wait to welcome you and your pet back soon.
Staff was amazing 👏 very loving workers. They fit me in a day early for my appointment and I referred my daughter and she will be taking her dog there.  Hazel …

My Gorda, loves coming to this place. The staff know her by name & she seems to enjoy her time there. I highly appreciate the ladies & all they do for us. My Gorda, loves to play all day & she needs a lot of attention.  She's literally 20 handfuls. I love her dearly. This place helps me out a lot when i need a break. I wish they could lower the overnight stays a little & i wish they had a monthly deal for day camp everyday. Other than that, i really appreciate this place a lot for all they do. Thank you!!!
It was my boys first time staying there and they seemed to really enjoy it and were sad to leave when I picked them up. The staff was friendly and professional.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had a wonderful experience! Our dog absolutely loved staying there and seemed happy and well cared for. The staff was friendly, professional, and made us feel comfortable leaving our pet in their care. The facility was clean, and the pricing was very reasonable at only $27 per day. It’s hard to find quality pet care at such a fair price. We will definitely be bringing our dog back and highly recommend this place to other pet owners!
The staff and facility is wonderful! They take wonderful care of my baby
Hi, Amaya. We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive review. We hope to welcome you and your furry friend back to Paradise soon!
My fur babies are frequent boarders at the Hobby location!  The staff is amazing!  I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my girls.  Thank you again Melissa for helping with Chillie’s especially.
Hi, Tiffany. Thank you for the wonderful rating! We can't wait to welcome you and your pet back soon.

We appreciate your feedback, William. If you would like to discuss your experience further, don't hesitate to reach out to us at (713) 941-3647 or hobby@petparadise.com. We would love the opportunity to learn more.
A great place if you are ever in Houston Texas.

Thank you for sharing your thoughts, Hanna. We’d love to hear more about your recent experience and how we can create a better impression. If there's anything we can do to improve your experience, please feel free to give us a call at (713) 941-3647.
They ware so heart warming. Made Bruce are Havanese fill good and calm. he looked so good. we will be back again.
My pet smelled so good and his haircut was excellent.

Our furry pet seamed to have had a great experience during her visit at Pet Paradise. She is not usually friendly with everyone but she got along with them. Staff was very nice and friendly and gave my dog an extra free play date so that she would be more comfortable before her initial stay. She was happy and ready to go home when we picked her up. The next morning, she acted like she was ready to go back there. We’ve decided that every so often, we’re going to let her go for a play date because she has been a bit more friendly with some people.
Great with animals they are so good my little boy had a good time they took him out to play send me a picture of them very nice
Hi, Melissa. Thank you so much for leaving such a great review and rating! We are so happy to hear that you had a positive experience with us.
Hi, Mafie. We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a positive review. We hope to welcome you and your furry friend back to Paradise soon!
Hi, Steve. Thank you for the wonderful rating! We can't wait to welcome you and your pet back soon.
Hi, Angie. Thank you so much for leaving such a great review and rating! We are so happy to hear that you had a positive experience with us.
Took great care of my dog, will use them again

this is like saint’s fourth time coming here and he’s always excited. This is his second home! I love these people and I’m so glad to have them. The convenience of easy checking in and checking out is also perfect.
Hi, Natalie. Your feedback is very important to us, so thank you for the great rating! We can't wait to welcome you and your pet back to Paradise soon.
My fur babies love Pet Paradise Hobby. The staff is great with my 6 year old and my 16 year old.
Hi, Julie. We appreciate the great star rating and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

Pet Paradise Hobby has been taking care of our pets for many years. We can enjoy our vacation knowing our pets are being well cared for. You can watch your pups playtime’s on the webcams. The staff does an amazing job!!
Pups seem to like coming here. Staff was very sweet and helpful when we had a travel delay.

Best place hands down! They take such pride and care on watching my fur kids. Obviously my dogs don’t like going there because they are attached to my hip, but I wouldn’t leave them anywhere else when I have to go out of town! They even call the next day to check on them and see how they are doing. Can’t beat the service and level of attention!
Hi, Kyle. Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a positive review. We appreciate you and your furry friend being part of the Pet Paradise family.

It was hard finding place that truly loves dogs and truly take care of them. I came across Pet Paradise searching. Did a trial run with overnight stay in daycare and my dogs loved it. The staff is wonderful   Very helpful very consumed especially with your first time like me they made me feel comfortable and even more so made me feel that my dog will be safe definitely a place I recommend

Woody's first time for boarding went very well.  We were notified that he developed a bloody nose and they watched him closely until it stopped.  He was groomed and came home fluffy and smelling good.  All in all, his first boarding seems to have been a success.  Thanks to all at Pet Paradise.
My doodles love coming to play with all of their friends! The play timers are the best and take the best care of my doggies!!
Great experience,  will definitely entrust my Scooby with them again . Jessica  took time to visit & sit with my Scooby.
Hi, Angela. We are so happy that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us! We can't wait to welcome you and your pet back to Paradise soon.
Love bringing my doggy here for quick baths and for overnight stays. They took the most precious pictures of my mushu I love them so much
The staff is always very friendly and knowledgeable. I have boarded Candy twice and have been very pleased with the treatment she received.
Great place for your pet
Hi, Lisa. We appreciate the great star rating and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Highly recommend Pet Paradise Hobby!
My sweet GrandPup went here for the first time on yesterday and I believe that he had a blast! I don’t think that he wanted to leave lol. He is already booked for his next play date! Can’t wait!
What an amazing place to take your animals wether it's for work or for holidays!!! Your little babies will enjoying staying here.
Hi, Graciela. Your feedback is very important to us, so thank you for the great rating! We can't wait to welcome you and your pet back to Paradise soon.
We just moved to the area and Lux had been really shy and reserved since everything is so new, but since staying at Pet Paradise Lux has really opened up again and is back to his happy, goofy self.
Always a pleasure to bring our dog here.
Very professional and Teamwork environment!
Hi, Jessica. We appreciate the great star rating and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
My 4 legged baby was well taken care of and we could tell! Put my mind at ease knowing she was in good hands!!
Hi, Ashia. Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a positive review. We appreciate you and your furry friend being part of the Pet Paradise family.

I didn’t have to drop off my boy until a few hours before I had to leave . Even better was not having to wait the weekend to pick him up! He’s healthy, happy and I know that he was well cared for while I was away.

We love this place so much. We’ve been going here for years. The staffs were very attentive and would give you an immediate calls if they have any concerns. My dog also LOVES this place. He would get super excited to come here and have fun with everyone. I feel safe leaving him here and enjoy his stay.

I can’t say enough great things about Pet Paradise Houston Hobby! From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm, welcoming, and clearly passionate about animals. The facility is spotless, secure, and thoughtfully designed, featuring both indoor and outdoor play areas, including a bone-shaped pool that my pup absolutely loved.

What really stood out was the personalized care. The team took the time to get to know my dog’s personality and ensured she was paired with compatible playmates. I also appreciated the live webcams; they gave me peace of mind while I was away.
Bonus points for their convenient location near Hobby Airport and the military/first responder discount. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a safe, fun, and caring place for their furry family members!

First time grooming visit for my senior pup and they exceeded my expectations! I was a little concerned about my pups anxiety but he did great. The front staff was very welcoming and Nikya did an amazing groom! We will definitely be back!

Picked up my dog after a three-night stay and he had what they called, "happy tail" which is basically a wound. He was bloody and had hard bumps all over his neck when I picked him up!
In regards to the response by Pet Paradise, it was never mentioned to me in my conversations that my dog showed signs of "happy tail" at time of check in! This excessive bleeding only occurred after staying there and there appeared to be no attempt to aid my dog or clean him up!
Wonderful service, recommend and would go back
Great experience, our dogs are always excited to return to pet paradise.

Honestly, my dog happy I wish could a picture of what she does when we show up.  She stands up like a little kid on the counter table to look over.  The people there are nice I pretty weird person. But kind to me even if I'm weird my dog is happy. Plus they have dog training class . If my dog could talk I wonder what she would say. But from the look of the tail ori seem excited.

The staff is excellent and was inviting for  my dogs.  They were understanding this was the 1st time away for one of my dogs and accompanied her anxiety to a new place. My dogs came home happy, clean (after a great bath) and ready for a nap.

I have been boarding my dogs at the Hobby location for many years.  These folks love animals, and my dog babies love them! My  most recent addition found us and was afraid of most people. The groomer took time with him and called to say he did okay with a bath but other services stressed him.  I really appreciated the call and modified his services.  Kelly and the gang call Peanut by name and he runs in for camp as does my border collie!  My BC is comfortable with smaller dogs and they placed her in her comfort zone.  They are exhausted after an excellent day out! Love them all!❤️

I highly recommend trying the day camp prior to boarding for the babies to acclimate themselves.  I take mine there on occasion even when I work from home because it’s very reasonably priced and they look forward to the visit with the Hunan friends as well as the other dogs.

Per Paradise is amazing. My boy Blu loves it there. After numerous failed attempts to find a place I’m glad I find them. They are always excited to see him and know him soon as he walks in. I’m at peace leaving him there when I have to leave for work.

took my dog there for two nights. she came home and had all the treats i packed eaten (which i over packed to be safe) and she was vomiting and had diarrhea. not to mention their cameras were down the whole time and i never got to check in on my dog.  the staff seemed nice but they know absolutely nothing about animals and my dog WILL NOT be going back there.
Hi, Cynthia. Thank you so much for leaving such a great review! We are so happy to hear that you had a positive experience with us.
I'm very particular of who grooms my dog..my standard poodle looked fabulous!!!! Thanks to Randy... she loved you and I knew she was in good hands...
Great experience, the staff was nice and caring for my animals. Treated them like true VIP. Bryan was such a big help and made it so easy for us after day .

Do not bring your dogs here because they just want to keep them inside all day and only let the dogs come outside 3 times a day .And not  keep their doggy door open so they can go in and out .what is the point of bringing a dog to daycare if they can't move around and play with other dogs

I have tried a couple different dog boarding/day care places but this place definitely has given me the best peace of mind and care for my dogs. Will definitely keep bringing them back - the staff are great and truly care about the pets and the prices aren’t bad at all!
All I'm gonna say is they're not good with cats...they were scared to handle my cat and I saw something about using net to catch her....

Pet Paradise is absolutely amazing! 🐾 From the moment I walked in, the staff made me and my pet feel so welcome and cared for. The facility is spotless, safe, and full of fun activities for pets. I love the attention to detail, the friendly team, and how genuinely they care about the animals. My pet always comes home happy, healthy, and full of energy after every visit. Highly recommend Pet Paradise to any pet parent looking for a trustworthy and loving place! ❤️🐶🐱

We appreciate your feedback, Crash. If you would like to discuss your experience further, don't hesitate to reach out to us at (713) 941-3647 or feedback@petparadiseresort.com. We would love the opportunity to learn more.

My Maltize  was very matted. The groomers did a excellent 👌 job of cutting ✂️ Shampoo. And Condition her skin. Not a Nick on skin. Yoshi was happy and so was I can't wait to take her again..  very pleased with checking in and out . Thanks pet paradise.. …
Wonderful facility and friendly staff 🐕🐕🐕 …
Bryan was very helpful and friendly! Will be back very soon!
All of the employees that I have interfaced with have been enthusiastic and very helpful in dealing with our rescue. Great place and even better crew. Thank you.

I'm really disappointed with the way this place handled my dog's stay. When I picked him up, he had a large infected rash, and no one had informed me about it. I called and emailed and left a voice mail,no response. The only time they got back to me was after I left a negative review in their survey. They promised to call me and check the cameras, but it's been over 3 weeks and I've heard nothing since.

I understand that things can happen with pets, but the complete lack of communication and follow-up is unacceptable. If I'm going to pay full price for boarding, I expect my dog to be properly cared for and, at the very least, to be informed when something goes wrong.

I won't be bringing my dog back not just because of what happened, but because they never called me back or followed up.
Hi, Yamila. We love to hear that you and your furry friend enjoyed their time in Paradise! We can't wait to welcome you back soon.
Extremely Friendly and Professional staff.  My dog Cassanova was absolutely beautiful when I picked him up.  Thanks guys for the love you showed my little ANGLE, CASSANOVA.

We took our dog Mila there in July for the first time. We were going on vacation during the 4th and the place we normally take her to was booked. Another dog facility recommended Pet Paradise to us and they were able to take her. My husband was getting ready to cancel his plans if we could not find somewhere to keep her for us. Long story short. They were great. Sent us a photo of her while we’re in California. We have found a new location for Mila.
We always have a good feeling when boarding our dogs here.  Never easy to leave your pets behind, but, knowing they are safe and taken care of truly helps.

We were very pleased with the service.  We had 2 GSD's boarding there.  One seemed to have enjoyed the entire experience.  The other became stressed and, therefore, had some diarrhea and vomiting.  The staff was quick to notify us of the concern.  We really appreciated their attention to our dog.  All is well now - just needed home sweet home.  Thanks, Pet Paradise!

Amazing place with truly wonderful people. My dogs always come home smelling great and stay that way for weeks. What really keeps us coming back is the staff they’re incredibly friendly, kind, and genuinely loving toward the animals. It makes all the difference.

I love this place. The staff were nice, intelligent, knowledgeable and friendly. My dog was just as clean when l took him there as when l picked him up. The staff seemed to have loved my dog. They seemed very caring and understood that dogs are more like humans than we think  they are. They love to be recognized and that is what they did.
Melissa was so great and I loved how she was so patient during our stay with our fur baby. 10/10 recommend this place!

First off, the location of facility is very convenient.  When I walked in to drop off my fur babies the staff was very friendly.  During my time away I was informed by the pet report card of how my pups were doing and behaving and from their pictures they looked very happy.  When I called to say I would be a little late picking them up, the representative Sandy answered the line and responded that it would be okay as long as it was before 12pm noon. Once I arrived to get my fur  babies they were happy, healthy and energetic; they enjoyed their vacation.  Sandy checked me out and she was very friendly and she informed me of doggie day care packages.  Thank you Pet Paradise for taking good care of my Miller & Ozzie! I will definitely be bringing them back again.
,
Genial
Hi, Ashley. Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a positive review. We appreciate you and your furry friend being part of the Pet Paradise family.
It's a great place for my fur babe to go and hang out. 🫶😄 …
Great place to broad your fur baby while you travel.

Please read all the reviews in this place. These people are liars. I may have been born at night but not last night. I boarded all 3 of my dogs. And we requested photos on them. They only would send pictures of only one of them. Then when I asked where’s the full body pictures of my other two dogs they wanted to lie and say their system was “down” but every day they were submitting photos and progress reports on one of them. LOL. Please don’t bring your dogs here. Mine were left abandoned and we were told that we were gonna be able to see them through the webcams, the next day came and they said they weren’t gonna be visible throughout their WHOLE STAY. They never let them out to play NOTHING. You’re paying to have your dog abandoned, smelling like pee since they don’t clean up their accidents they just let them lay in it, oh and I requested ice cream, of course they didn’t give it to my dog. FIRST AND LAST TIME BOARDING MY PETS HERE.
I have been boarding my pets here for 9 years 4 star customer service and I am worry free when I board them here

please read all the  bad reviews on this place before booking. I really regret not going with my intuition about this place.  We took our dog here for the first time and we payed extra for ice cream as well as daily pictures. Day 1 came by dog didnt recieve the ice cream. Also didnt recieve a daily update on him. apprently we we’rent on the list for an update and even the person at the front desk was confused as to why we were not on there. I checked the online webcams to see him throughout the day and actually there was no dogs playing around they had them locked up all day. Probably another reason why we didnt get pictures of him! The weather was also not an excuse because it wasnt raining nor were the tempetures too high. Please don’t bring your dog here!!! Your basiclly paying for them to be abandonded and locked in their kennels ALL DAY!
Paradise is a great place for pets go to visit. For more than 10 now my pets have been going to Pet Paradise.
My Bo was well taken care of at the Hobby Pet Paradise.  They provided me with a detailed report card and pictures.  Truly grateful!
Oscar had a great experience at Pet Paradise/Hobby. They seem to really care about the animals left in their care. I won't mind leaving him there when we go out of town.
Coco loves Pet Paradise.  Considers the facility her second home and the team her second family!!
The girls love it. Fast, affordable daycare.

My dog stayed here for 5 days and they took real good care of him. His 13 years old senior and they made adjustments for him. Appreciate the staff smooth way of dealing the boarding and handing pets back. Very professional. Thank you so much for taking care of Thor.

My baby loves coming here! She has the best time and they treat her so well! I tried them out for boarding when I went out of town and now I use them for day camp. The staff is very professional, polite, and efficient. The prices are very reasonable for the services they provide but the love and attention my baby gets at Pet Paradise is invaluable. Thank y’all so much for the care you provide!!!
Great service, recommend for your pets. You can tell they are animals lovers
The staff is great, my bully loves going to today camp.
It was very affordable! My pets seemed very happy when we went to pick them up! I think next time we will try the pool!
Great service and value. Super friendly staff.

I have NEVER been to a grooming/boarding business that has such TERRIBLE front desk staff. I was told when booking to drop my babies off at 6am and bring proper vaccination records, when I get to Pet Paradise the office was closed and there were other cars waiting in line who I assumed also didn’t know they opened at 6:30, my partner and I waited for them to open, once they did we made it inside with our babies. The front desk staff was no where near personable when we walked in no hello or good morning granted it was early, the young lady who was supposed to “help” started to check us in, we show her the vaccination records we have and she states we do not have two others she needs, at that point instead of telling us we can’t bring the dogs today she lets us stand there for another 5-10min not saying she should would be able to help or otherwise but instead still acting like she can check us in, when after that time period of just standing around and her staring at us like she has no clue how her job works, I ask are we even gonna be able to leave them if we don’t have the records you need she said No they can’t stay, when I ask why she didn’t say that initially when she knew we didn’t have the records, all she did was shrug and go I don’t know, with an insincere I’m sorry. This place was extremely unprofessional with how they handled the matter and for this to be my FIRST experience I would never come back!

I’ve used Pet Paradise in multiple cities and decided to try this location after moving to Houston. However, I’ve had recurring issues—feeding mistakes, lost toys, and not receiving the correct amount of leftover food, which is expensive.

During my dog’s last stay, I provided clear feeding instructions, emphasizing that he had already eaten and didn’t need food until the next day. They ignored this, ran out of food, and I was out of town, unable to provide more. Upset, I spoke to a manager who assured me that only managers would handle his feeding moving forward.

Despite this, during his most recent stay while I was recovering from surgery, they again fed him incorrectly. I received a call at 6 PM asking what to do because he wasn’t eating—after I had explicitly stated multiple times that he didn’t need food that day. Once food is placed down, they can’t take it back, meaning they wasted it. Since I only pack enough for his stay, this puts him at risk of running out. It’s frustrating that they don’t communicate or follow simple instructions—how can I trust them with his overall care?

Emma, a front-of-house manager, listened to my frustrations and updated my file again to ensure only managers feed him. She also provided her personal number for updates and added the Forever Connect feature, which offers photos and daily reports. While I appreciate her efforts, it still doesn’t give me confidence that instructions will be followed. She also helped resolve an issue with my profile and points system, which I’m grateful for. Without her, I would have left a 1-star review.

When picking up my dog, I mentioned I had surgery and needed him to stay calm. As I instructed him to sit before greeting him, a staff member dismissively told me, “Oh, just pet him—he just wants love.” Of course, I want to love on my dog, but he’s trained to sit first, and I had stitches to protect. The comment felt unnecessary. Also, I noticed that while there’s usually one person at the front desk, when I arrived to pick him up after expressing my concerns, suddenly six people were there, making me feel like they were waiting to see the “problem client.”

I have upcoming trips and am hesitant to use this location again. I don’t want another call about my dog not eating due to them disregarding instructions. It may seem minor, but wasted food adds up, and being contacted mid-trip for more food—when they were the ones who mismanaged it—is frustrating.
We love bringing our dog here. He loves going and playing.

This place used to be a place, I loved for my standard poodle to go hang out. A month ago I was put on their schedule, because a spot came  open. I always spoke to the groomer every time, because I have a standard with a lot of hair. After 9 in half hours her hair wasn’t done, had to come back the next day. They care more about making each other look and sound good, then listening to the client. I dealt with very unprofessional comments and rude remarks. They lost my business.
They were so awesome in caring for my fur baby.

I’VE NEVER IN MY LIFE EXPERIENCED SUCH A TERRIBLE GROOMING SERVICE EVER!!!
Understood, my fur baby had a little bit of matting under his chest but to cut his whole body damn near bald is crazy & it seemed like they just got lazy and just cut it all off. I don’t understand how this looks okay, he looks completely unrecognizable, I’ll NEVER trust them to groom my dog ever again!!
Did a great job watching my babies! Will be using them again!

Our dog-child loves his vacations there, the staff loves him, and he has a variety of activities to do. I also love that he has his own room with a patio. Plus, the staff is AMAZING, very accommodating and friendly.

My dog has been twice. After his 1st stay, the next day he was diagnosed with kennel cough.
Since I did not know how he got the illness, I took him back 2 months later. Only this time, he had diarrhea and a gash on his leg!
Im not sure what happened, as the cameras are blurry and I couldnt ALWAYS see my dog, but he will never return to this place!

We've been having our 2 dogs stay at Pet Paradise Hobby for over 10 years now, and the facility and its team continue to be *amazing.* Having grown up together (and now being 8 and 12 years old), our dogs are bonded and always roomed …
We’ve been taking our furry friends there for years. Their customer service has never wavered. Always at the top of our list when it’s time to take care of our dogs when we’re gone

Brought my dogs here for the new customers free boarding and was told wrong pricing 4 different times. I tried to confirm at drop off the price since I was told different things two days before drop off. When dropping off Kelli talked over …
